heading: Services
subtext: Five core services to help you build, automate and scale your business with the right technology.
alsoOffered: UI/UX Development · Website Maintenance · Video Editing · Photo Editing

items.title: Website Development
items.summary: Responsive, fast-loading business websites optimized for SEO and lead generation.
items.detail: We build business websites, landing pages and portfolios from scratch. Every site is mobile-first, passes Core Web Vitals and ships with a working contact form, SEO structure and deployment to GitHub Pages or cPanel.
includes: Responsive layout from 320 px to 1920 px
Contact form wired to Google Sheets
SEO meta tags, sitemap and robots.txt

items.title: Web Application Development
items.summary: Custom dashboards, management portals, booking systems, and business applications.
items.detail: We design and build web apps around the way your team actually works — not off-the-shelf software that forces you to adapt. Typical projects include inventory systems, booking portals, admin dashboards and multi-user management tools.
includes: Deployment to shared or VPS hosting

items.title: Python Automation
items.summary: Automated workflows, data processing, repetitive tasks, and integrations.
items.detail: If your team repeats the same data task every day, we can automate it. Common projects: reading emails and updating spreadsheets, scraping data and generating reports, scheduling jobs, processing files in bulk.
includes: Windows Task Scheduler or cron setup

items.title: AI Solutions
items.summary: Practical AI-powered solutions and intelligent business workflows.
items.detail: We build AI tools that solve a specific problem, not demos. Typical projects: CSV upload and instant analysis with charts, document Q&A with an LLM, automated report summarisation, predictive models on business data.
includes: Problem scoping before choosing a model

items.title: API Integration
items.summary: Connect third-party APIs, payment gateways, and existing business systems.
items.detail: We wire together the platforms you already use so they share data without manual copying. Typical integrations: Razorpay or Stripe payments, Shopify orders into ERP, WhatsApp Business notifications, third-party CRM sync.

items.title: UI/UX Development
items.summary: Interfaces built for real users: clear hierarchy, fast interactions, accessible.
items.detail: We build the front-end layer for web apps where the UI matters — dashboards, customer portals, admin interfaces.

items.title: Website Maintenance
items.summary: Ongoing bug fixes, updates, security patches and performance work.
items.detail: We handle the ongoing work that keeps a website running well.

items.title: Video Editing
items.summary: Promotional videos, reels and product demos edited for your brand.
items.detail: We edit promotional videos, product walkthroughs, Instagram and YouTube reels.

items.title: Photo Editing
items.summary: Product retouching, background removal and brand graphic creation.
items.detail: We retouch product photos, remove or replace backgrounds, create social media graphics and produce brand assets for web and print.

items.title: Business Automation
items.summary: End-to-end automation for reporting, approvals and notifications.
items.detail: Beyond single scripts, we build complete automation pipelines.
includes: Process mapping before any code is written
